name: Aqua-Terrarium 60x35x45x30
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 60x35x45 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 30 cm.

description.html: The 60x35x45 cm aqua-terrarium from our workshop solves the problem of keeping species that live where water meets land. Glass of a thickness matched to the water pressure holds a 30 cm water column, with a land section above it for basking and resting.

The horizontal layout with 60 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Reptile thermoregulation depends on being able to move between warm and cool zones inside the terrarium. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.
Aqua-terrariums are designed for species that need both a land and a water section in their habitat:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
